\pdfvariable compresslevel=0
\pdfvariable objcompresslevel=0
\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Melody Syntax Test}]{ulsbs-songbook}
\begin{document}
\begin{songs}{}
\beginsong{Melody Syntax}[key={C}]
  \mnbeginverse
    \[<C>]one \[<C D E>Am]two \[<;E>]three \[<C;E>Am]four
    \[<C D;E F>G]five \[<C @ .3em>]six \[<C @ -.3em>Am]seven
    \[<C D;E F @ .3em>]eight \[<A _ C;E _ G>]gaps \[</>Am]unpitched \[<A / C;E _ G>]slash slot \[<* A _ * C>Am]beats
    \[<A B C;E * G>Am]secondary beat \[<* @ 1em>]beat-only offset
    \[<C# D& F;A C>Am]accidentals
    \[<*A_C;E*G@.2em>Am]compact
    \[<!C>]zero-advance note \[<!*>]zero-advance beat \[<!ABC@1em>Am]zero-advance adjusted melody with chord
  \mnendverse
  {\melodySecondaryPosition{below}\melodyStyleMapping{swapped}
    \mnbeginverse
      \[<C;E>Am]policy \[<C D;E F @ -.4em>G]offset \[<C D @ -.4em>]negative no chord
    \mnendverse}
  {\melodySecondaryPosition{same}
    \mnbeginverse
      \[<;E>Am]secondary normal lane \[<C;E>Am]explicit overlay
    \mnendverse}
  {\melodyPrimaryPosition{low}
    \beginverse
      {\melodySecondaryPosition{above}\[<C;E>Am]low/above}
      {\melodySecondaryPosition{same}\[<C;E>Am]low/same}
      {\melodySecondaryPosition{below}\[<C;E>Am]low/below}
    \endverse}
  \notesoff
  \mnbeginverse
    \[<C D;E F>Am]hidden notes \[<* C>G]visible beat
  \mnendverse
  \noteson\beatsoff
  \mnbeginverse
    \[<* C>Am]hidden beat
  \mnendverse
  \beatson\transpose{2}
  \mnbeginverse
    \[<C D# E& /;A C>Am]transposed
  \mnendverse
\endsong
\end{songs}
\makeatletter
\melodyStyleMapping{normal}\UL@melodystyle{primary}
\ifUL@altmnstyle\PackageError{melody-syntax}{normal primary style was alternate}{}\fi
\UL@melodystyle{secondary}
\ifUL@altmnstyle\else\PackageError{melody-syntax}{normal secondary style was primary}{}\fi
\melodyStyleMapping{swapped}\UL@melodystyle{primary}
\ifUL@altmnstyle\else\PackageError{melody-syntax}{swapped primary style was not alternate}{}\fi
\UL@melodystyle{secondary}
\ifUL@altmnstyle\PackageError{melody-syntax}{swapped secondary style was not primary}{}\fi
\melodyStyleMapping{normal}
\newdimen\ULtestslot
\newdimen\ULtestexpected
\newcount\ULtestassertion
\newsavebox\ULtestminwidthbox
\def\ULtestassert#1#2{\advance\ULtestassertion by 1\ifdim#1=#2\else\errmessage{melody dimension assertion \the\ULtestassertion failed}\fi}
\def\ULtestposition#1#2#3#4{%
  \melodyPrimaryPosition{#1}\melodySecondaryPosition{#2}%
  \setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@melodyparse{C;E}\UL@melodyrender
  \begingroup\ulChordFont
    \ULtestexpected=#3ex\relax\ULtestassert{\UL@primaryheight}{\ULtestexpected}%
    \ULtestexpected=#4ex\relax\ULtestassert{\UL@secondaryheight}{\ULtestexpected}%
  \endgroup
}
\ULtestposition{normal}{above}{\mnnormalheightfactor}{\mnhighheightfactor}
\ULtestposition{normal}{same}{\mnnormalheightfactor}{\mnnormalheightfactor}
\ULtestposition{normal}{below}{\mnnormalheightfactor}{\mnlowheightfactor}
\ULtestposition{low}{above}{\mnlowheightfactor}{\mnnormalheightfactor}
\ULtestposition{low}{same}{\mnlowheightfactor}{\mnlowheightfactor}
\ULtestposition{low}{below}{\mnlowheightfactor}{\mnlowestheightfactor}
\melodyPrimaryPosition{normal}\melodySecondaryPosition{above}
\sbox\ULtestminwidthbox{{\lyricfont\hspace{\ulChordWhitespaceMinimumWidth}}}
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{\kern.1pt}\UL@annotationcurrentwidth=\wd\SB@chordbox\UL@annotationvisibletrue\UL@annotationapplyminwidth
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{\wd\ULtestminwidthbox}
\ULtestexpected=\wd\ULtestminwidthbox\multiply\ULtestexpected by 2
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{\kern\ULtestexpected}\UL@annotationcurrentwidth=\wd\SB@chordbox\UL@annotationvisibletrue\UL@annotationapplyminwidth
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{\ULtestexpected}
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{\kern.1pt}\UL@annotationcurrentwidth=\wd\SB@chordbox\UL@annotationvisiblefalse\UL@annotationapplyminwidth
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{.1pt}
{\renewcommand{\ulChordWhitespaceMinimumWidth}{0pt}%
 \setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{\kern.1pt}\UL@annotationcurrentwidth=\wd\SB@chordbox\UL@annotationvisibletrue\UL@annotationapplyminwidth
 \ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{.1pt}}
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@annotationvisiblefalse\UL@melodyparse{*}\UL@melodyrender
\ifUL@annotationvisible\else\errmessage{visible beat was not marked visible}\fi
\beatsoff\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@annotationvisiblefalse\UL@melodyparse{*}\UL@melodyrender
\ifUL@annotationvisible\errmessage{hidden beat was marked visible}\fi
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{0pt}\beatson
\notesoff\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@annotationvisiblefalse\UL@melodyparse{C}\UL@melodyrender
\ifUL@annotationvisible\errmessage{hidden note was marked visible}\fi
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{0pt}\noteson
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@melodyparse{!ABC}\UL@melodyrender
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{0pt}
\ifUL@annotationminimumdisabled\else\errmessage{zero-advance melody did not disable whitespace minimum}\fi
\UL@annotationcurrentwidth=\wd\SB@chordbox\UL@annotationvisibletrue\UL@annotationapplyminwidth
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{0pt}
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{\kern2em}\ULtestexpected=\wd\SB@chordbox
\UL@melodyparse{!ABC}\UL@melodyrender
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{\ULtestexpected}
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@melodyparse{A _ C}\UL@melodyrender
\ULtestslot=\UL@melodyslotwidth
\ULtestexpected=\ULtestslot\multiply\ULtestexpected by 3
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{\ULtestexpected}
\ULtestassert{\wd\UL@melodyprimarybox}{\ULtestexpected}
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@melodyparse{A B C;E _ G}\UL@melodyrender
\ULtestassert{\wd\UL@melodysecondarybox}{\ULtestexpected}
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@melodyparse{*A_C;E*G}\UL@melodyrender
\ULtestassert{\wd\UL@melodyprimarybox}{\ULtestexpected}
\ULtestexpected=\ULtestslot\multiply\ULtestexpected by 2
\ULtestassert{\wd\UL@melodysecondarybox}{\ULtestexpected}
\ULtestexpected=\ULtestslot\advance\ULtestexpected by \UL@melodybeatwidth
\ULtestassert{\UL@melodybeatextent}{\ULtestexpected}
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox{}\UL@melodyparse{A * C;E _ G}\UL@melodyrender
\ULtestexpected=\ULtestslot\advance\ULtestexpected by \UL@melodybeatwidth
\ULtestassert{\UL@melodybeatextent}{\ULtestexpected}
\ULtestexpected=\ULtestslot\multiply\ULtestexpected by 4
\setbox\SB@chordbox\hbox to\ULtestexpected{}\UL@melodyparse{A}\UL@melodyrender
\ULtestassert{\wd\SB@chordbox}{\ULtestexpected}
\begingroup\catcode`\@=12
\gdef\ULtestoffsetcases{%
  \setbox\csname SB@chordbox\endcsname\hbox{}%
  \csname UL@melodyparse\endcsname{A @ 1em}%
  \csname UL@melodyrender\endcsname
  \ULtestexpected=\ULtestslot\advance\ULtestexpected by 1em%
  \ULtestassert{\wd\csname SB@chordbox\endcsname}{\ULtestexpected}%
  \setbox\csname SB@chordbox\endcsname\hbox{}%
  \csname UL@melodyparse\endcsname{A @ -1em}%
  \csname UL@melodyrender\endcsname
  \ULtestassert{\wd\csname SB@chordbox\endcsname}{\ULtestslot}%
}
\endgroup
{\lyricfont\ULtestoffsetcases}
\ifcsname mn\endcsname\errmessage{legacy melody macro still defined}\fi
\ifcsname bm\endcsname\errmessage{legacy beat macro still defined}\fi
\makeatother
\end{document}
